ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface, with an estimated ratio of approximately 92% dark pixels to 8% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black regions dominate both lobes. High-contrast white focal clusters are localized on the distal tips of both lobes. Scattered, low-density white pixel mottling is distributed irregularly across the central surface of the left and right lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: Two avian subjects (birds) are present in the foreground, partially occluding the central-left and far-right sections of the fluke lobes.
